gen-gf-revalia-mulish: Mulish reads soft and open, with rod-like strokes and a big x-height. Revalia sits above it, loud and widely spaced, and the two make a pair that is bold at the top and easygoing below.
gen-gf-wallpoet-inter: Stencil-cut and loud, Wallpoet announces itself with high-rising lowercase. And Inter, smooth as tubing with roomy counters, would make that heading look cramped and shaky if the heading were shrunk down.
gen-gf-warnes-instrument-sans: Warnes stretches out wide, its ink strokes tapering off before they meet, all bold and expressive. Instrument Sans follows with a uniform weight and small cap-to-lowercase steps, a quiet, modern counterweight to all that flourish.
gen-mystery-quest-rubik: Bookish and a little nostalgic, Mystery Quest has open jaws on every curve and compact ascenders. Rubik takes over in a soft sans-serif whose big lowercase and round shapes stay clear at small sizes.
gen-gf-tektur-mulish: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes and oversized lowercase make it the loudest voice here. Mulish then settles things down as a plain sans with a large x-height and curves that never thicken or thin.
gen-irish-grover-instrument-sans: Irish Grover makes its words look sturdy, with tall lowercase and gently varied strokes that feel hand-made. And Instrument Sans, a plain sans of unvarying weight, is the one to enlarge a notch if the text feels slight.
gen-luckiest-guy-inter: Inter is a smooth, tubelike sans-serif with generous counters. Luckiest Guy shouts above it, cheerful and poured-looking, and that gap in volume is what gives the pair its character.
gen-tourney-bitter: Tourney stretches its words wide with chunky, uniformly cut strokes and an athletic swagger that is hard to miss. Bitter's slab-serif body grounds it.
gen-audiowide-poppins: Poppins reads smooth and sturdy, its loose curves never knotting at the ends. And Audiowide, tile-like and futuristic, would sit above it while the body keeps text flowing easily line after line.
gen-gf-funnel-display-poppins: Spaghetti-thin, same-width strokes give Funnel Display a commanding, expressive look with c tips that stay well apart. Poppins sits below as a modern sans with sturdy lowercase.
